writing.target: An honest person tells the truth.
Lan is generous. She shares her snacks.
A good friend is|My best friend and I|I'm sorry

text_en: Hoa and Mai are best friends.
They have a lot in common.
They both love drawing and reading.
Mai borrowed Hoa's new pens and lost one.
Hoa was upset and said something mean.
Mai felt sad, and the two girls didn't talk for two days.
She bought Hoa a new pen with her pocket money.
Hoa said sorry too, because she was rude.
They forgave each other and made up.
Now they know that good friends are honest and kind, and they say sorry when they make mistakes.

questions.q: What do Hoa and Mai both love?

options: Mai lost one of her pens.
questions.answer: Mai lost one of her pens.
